free_tier.stated: No published storage quota. Site advertises 'no seat limits, no repository caps'; Forgejo ships quota disabled by default (quota.ENABLED=false, quota.default.TOTAL=-1 = unlimited), and this instance exposes no quota documentation.

egress.terms: No metered download policy published; Cloudflare-fronted. Not contradicted anywhere on the instance.

tooling: Full Forgejo API v1 with Swagger at /api/swagger; OCI registry at /v2/; generic package registry; LFS; Actions on an owner-run runner.
chaining: Unknown per-account cap x unlimited free accounts. If the default holds (TOTAL=-1), each account is effectively unbounded — this is the 'unlimited free identity x no quota' case, strictly better than CodeFloe but with zero published guarantee.
limits_note: Unstated. No per-file cap documented. Small instance (29 public repos observed via API search), self-hosted runner, Patreon-funded. Accounts left unactivated are auto-removed.
reliability_note: Hobby instance run by one admin; tiny disk budget implied by the funding model. Unpublished quota means an admin can introduce one at any moment with no notice. Data-loss risk is materially higher than a commercial forge.

evidence.proved: 'Public and private repositories, no seat limits, no repository caps'; 'Full API access ... documented with Swagger'
probe: GET -> 401 with Bearer realm https://git.neoneko.org/v2/token (registry enabled, not a stub)
probe: GET -> 29 repos (small instance, quota never exercised at scale)

notes: No published storage quota. Site advertises 'no seat limits, no repository caps'; Forgejo ships quota disabled by default (quota.ENABLED=false, quota.default.TOTAL=-1 = unlimited), and this instance exposes no quota documentation.
binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
